title: pubsub2pubsub Channel Template
description: Configuration template for a pubsub2pubsub message routing channel. Defines pub/sub sides (sources and/or sinks), the flow router that connects them, and backend-specific settings.

channelId.description: Unique channel identifier. Use -1 to request auto-assignment.

collectMetrics.description: Whether to collect runtime metrics for this channel.

metricsIntervalInMs.description: Interval in milliseconds at which metrics are collected and reported.

ticketRefillOnBusyCycle.description: Number of processing tickets refilled per busy cycle. Controls throughput throttling.

PubSubSides.description: Named pub/sub endpoints. Each key is a user-defined side ID (e.g. 'kafka-source', 'storage-sink').

IntOrString.description: Accepts both integer and string representations of a number.

NumberOrString.description: Accepts both number (incl. float) and string representations.

BoolOrString.description: Accepts both boolean and string boolean representations.

JournalConfig.description: Configuration for binary journaling of pub/sub messages, used for recovery and replay.

useJournal.description: Whether to enable journaling for this client/topic.

journalType.description: Format of the journal. Currently 'binary' is the supported type.

journalPath.description: VFS path for the journal files. Supports template variables: {clientType}, {clientInstance}, {topicName}.

BinarySerializerOptions.description: Controls which fields are included in binary serialization of pub/sub messages.

msgDateTimeAsMsSinceUnixEpochInUtc.description: Encode timestamp as milliseconds since Unix epoch (UTC).

msgMetaDataKeyValuePairsIncluded.description: Include the metadata key-value pair set.

SerializerOptions.description: Controls which fields are included in text/structured serialization of pub/sub messages.

msgPrimaryPayloadTypeIncluded.description: Include the MIME/type identifier for the primary payload.

includeUndefinedValues.description: Include fields whose values are undefined/null.

originTopicObjPointerIncluded.description: Include internal object pointer of origin topic (debug use).

originClientObjPointerIncluded.description: Include internal object pointer of origin client (debug use).

DesiredFeatures.description: Declares which pub/sub features this backend supports. Used by the framework to select compatible code paths. These are capability declarations, not configuration.

PubSubBookmarkPersistenceConfig.description: Configures how pub/sub progress bookmarks are persisted across restarts.

bookmarkNamespace.description: Namespace prefix for organizing bookmarks. Supports template variables.

autoPersistAlways.description: Persist bookmarks on every message regardless of other settings.

autoPersistIfClientSideBookmarksNeeded.description: Automatically persist bookmarks when the backend requires client-side bookmark tracking.

autoPersistIntervalInMs.description: Interval in milliseconds between automatic bookmark persistence operations.

autoPersistMsgInterval.description: Persist a bookmark every N messages.

maxNrOfBookmarksToKeep.description: Maximum number of historical bookmarks to retain.

vfsRootPath.description: VFS root path for storing bookmark files.

persistenceStructure.description: Path template for bookmark files. Supports: {bookmarkNamespace}, {clientType}, {topicName}.

RouteConfig.description: Defines a message flow route from a source side to one or more destination sides.

fromSideId.description: Side ID of the message source (must match a key in PubSubSides).

toSideId.description: Side ID of the primary message destination.

failoverSideId.description: Side ID to route to if the primary destination is unhealthy. Empty string disables failover.

spilloverBufferSideId.description: Side ID of a buffer side used for temporary spillover when the destination is under pressure. Empty string disables spillover.

deadLetterSideId.description: Side ID for messages that cannot be delivered. Empty string disables dead-letter routing.

toSideTopicsAutoMatchFromSide.description: Automatically match destination topics to source topics by name.

failoverSideTopicsAutoMatchFromSide.description: Automatically match failover side topics to source topics.

spilloverSideTopicsAutoMatchFromSide.description: Automatically match spillover side topics to source topics.

deadLetterSideTopicsAutoMatchFromSide.description: Automatically match dead-letter side topics to source topics.

preferFromTopicThreadForDestination.description: Use the source topic's thread for publishing to the destination, reducing context switches.

egressAllDiscoveredSpilloverTopicsOnStar.description: On startup, egress all topics already present in the spillover buffer.

autoAssociateTopicsAnyToAnyAcrossSides.description: Automatically create any-to-any topic associations between sides.

topicAssociations.description: Explicit topic routing associations between sides. Usually empty when auto-matching is enabled.

PubSubFlowRouterConfig.description: Controls how messages are routed between pub/sub sides, including failover and spillover behavior.

minBadHealthDurationBeforeFailoverInMs.description: Minimum duration (ms) a destination must be unhealthy before failover is triggered.

minBadHealthDurationBeforeSpilloverInMs.description: Minimum duration (ms) a destination must be unhealthy before spillover buffering is triggered.

minPrimarySideGoodHealthDurationBeforeAc.description: Minimum duration (ms) the primary side must be healthy before it becomes active.

minFailoverSideGoodHealthDurationBeforeA.description: Minimum duration (ms) a failover side must be healthy before it activates.

minSpilloverSideGoodHealthDurationBefore.description: Minimum duration (ms) a spillover side must be healthy before it activates.

routeSwitchingTimerIntervalInMs.description: Interval (ms) at which the router evaluates whether a route switch is needed.

PubSubSide.description: A single pub/sub endpoint - either a source (subscriber) or sink (publisher), or both.

allowOutOfOrderPublishRetry.description: Allow retrying failed publishes out of their original order.

needToTrackInFlightPublishedMsgsForAckDe.description: Whether to track in-flight published messages for acknowledgement by default.

allowTimedOutPublishedInFlightMsgsRetryO.description: Allow retrying timed-out in-flight published messages out of order.

applyThreadCpuAffinity.description: Pin the pub/sub thread to a specific CPU core.

cpuAffinityForPubSubThread.description: CPU core index to pin the pub/sub thread to (0-based). Requires applyThreadCpuAffinity=true.

maxMsgPublishRetryAttempts.description: Maximum number of times to retry a failed message publish.

maxMsgPublishRetryTotalTimeInMs.description: Maximum total time (ms) to spend retrying a failed publish before giving up.

maxPublishedMsgInFlightTimeInMs.description: Maximum time (ms) a published message may be in-flight before it is considered timed out.

maxTotalMsgsInFlight.description: Maximum number of messages that may be in-flight simultaneously for this side.

maxASyncPublishMailboxSize.description: Maximum size of the async publish mailbox under normal conditions.

maxASyncPublishMailboxSizeDuringAFR.description: Maximum size of the async publish mailbox during Accelerated Flow Recovery (AFR).

performPubSubInDedicatedThread.description: Run pub/sub operations in a dedicated thread rather than the shared thread pool.

retryFailedPublishAttempts.description: Whether to retry failed message publish attempts.

subscribeWithoutBookmarkIfNoneIsPersiste.description: Start subscribing from the beginning (or default offset) if no persisted bookmark is found.

PubSubClientConfigCommon.description: Common fields shared across all pub/sub client backend types.

pubsubClientType.description: Identifies the pub/sub backend plugin to use. Determines which fields are valid in CustomConfig.

reconnectDelayInMs.description: Delay (ms) before attempting to reconnect after a connection loss. Use 0 for immediate reconnect.

pubsubIdPrefix.description: Prefix for auto-generated pub/sub client IDs. Use '{auto}' for automatic generation.

maxTotalMsgsInFlight.description: Maximum number of messages that may be in-flight simultaneously across all topics.

RemoteAddresses.description: Remote host addresses for this backend. Format: 'host:port'. Can be an array or object.

anyOf.description: Object form with a single 'remoteAddress' field (legacy format).

RemoteAddressess.description: Alternative spelling of RemoteAddresses (legacy/typo variant). Use RemoteAddresses instead.

PubSubClientConfig.description: Backend-specific pub/sub client configuration. The 'pubsubClientType' field acts as a discriminator determining valid CustomConfig, defaultTopicConfig, and Topics content.

TopicConfigCommonFields.description: Common fields shared by all topic configurations regardless of backend.

isOptional.description: Whether failure to connect to or discover this topic is treated as non-fatal.

needPublishSupport.description: This topic requires publish (send) support from the backend.

needSubscribeSupport.description: This topic requires subscribe (receive) support from the backend.

preferDedicatedConnection.description: Request a dedicated connection for this topic rather than sharing a connection.

topicName.description: Backend-specific topic name. For MSMQ: queue path. For Kafka: topic name. For Redis: stream name. For STORAGE: sub-path. For UDP: interface label.

consumerGroupName.description: Consumer group name for backends that support consumer groups (e.g. Kafka).

consumerName.description: Unique consumer name within the consumer group. Supports template: $HOSTNAME$, {topicName}.

useTopicLevelMaxTotalMsgsInFlight.description: Override the client-level maxTotalMsgsInFlight with the topic-level value.

maxTotalMsgsInFlight.description: Topic-level cap on in-flight messages. Only used when useTopicLevelMaxTotalMsgsInFlight=true. Use -1 for unlimited.

KafkaLibrdkafkaConfig.description: Free-form librdkafka configuration properties. Field names use the librdkafka convention (dots allowed). Values may be string, integer, or boolean.

KafkaClientCustomConfig.description: Kafka client-level configuration. These settings apply to the Kafka producer or consumer globally.

KafkaConsumerGlobalConfig.description: Global librdkafka consumer configuration. Applied to all consumer connections. See librdkafka documentation for available keys.

KafkaProducerGlobalConfig.description: Global librdkafka producer configuration. Applied to all producer connections. See librdkafka documentation for available keys.

KafkaTopicCustomConfig.description: Kafka topic-level configuration controlling per-topic consumer/producer behavior.

addProducerHostnameAsKafkaMsgHeader.description: Add the producer's hostname as a Kafka message header.

consumerModeStartOffset.description: Consumer start offset strategy. Use 'stored' to resume from last committed offset, 'largest' for latest, 'smallest' for earliest.

kafkaMsgHeaderUsedForFiltering.description: Kafka message header name to use for consumer-side filtering.

kafkaMsgValuesUsedForFiltering.description: Comma-separated list of values to match against the filter header.

useKafkaMsgHeadersForConsumerFiltering.description: Enable filtering of consumed messages based on Kafka headers.

prefixToAddForKvPairs.description: Prefix to prepend to all key-value pair keys when producing.

prefixToAddForMetaDataKvPairs.description: Prefix to prepend to metadata key-value pair keys when producing.

stripPrefixForKvPairs.description: Strip the configured prefix from key-value pair keys when consuming.

stripPrefixForMetaDataKvPairs.description: Strip the configured prefix from metadata key-value pair keys when consuming.

maxKafkaErrorsToBeHealthy.description: Maximum number of consecutive Kafka errors before the topic is considered unhealthy. 0 = any error makes it unhealthy.

addReadyToTransmitTimeStampAsKafkaMetaDa.description: Add a 'ready to transmit' timestamp as a Kafka message header.

readyToTransmitTimeStampMetaDataKey.description: Key name for the ready-to-transmit timestamp header.

KafkaTopicConfigDirect.description: Kafka topic configuration with fields defined directly (without PubSubClientTopicConfig wrapper).

KafkaDefaultTopicConfig.description: Default Kafka topic configuration applied to all topics unless overridden in the Topics array.

KafkaTopicsConfig.description: Explicit list of Kafka topic configurations. Usually empty when defaultTopicConfig covers all topics.

simulateReceiveAckFeatureViaLookupId.description: Simulate message receive acknowledgement by using the MSMQ LookupId to track delivered messages.

gatherMsmqMetricForTotalBytesAllQueues.description: Collect the total bytes across all MSMQ queues as a metric.

convertMsmqClsIdToString.description: Convert the MSMQ class ID (CLSID) to a string representation.

convertMsmqMsgIdToString.description: Convert the MSMQ message ID to a string representation.

defaultMsmqBodyBufferSizeInBytes.description: Initial buffer size in bytes for the MSMQ message body. Grows automatically if needed.

gatherMsmqTransitTimeOnReceiveMetric.description: Measure and record the time between message send and receive as a metric.

maxMsmqMsgsToReadPerSyncCycle.description: Maximum number of MSMQ messages to read in a single synchronous processing cycle.

minPayloadFieldGrowthPercOnBufferTooSmal.description: Minimum percentage by which to grow the payload buffer when it is too small.

msmqMsgPropIdToMapToMsgIdOnReceive.description: MSMQ property ID whose value maps to the pubsub message ID on receive. Default 30 = PROPID_M_MSGID.

msmqPropIdsToReceive.description: Comma-separated list of MSMQ property IDs to retrieve on receive.

msmqPropIdsToSend.description: Comma-separated list of MSMQ property IDs to set on send. Empty = default set.

retainMsmqSentTimeAsMetaData.description: Store the MSMQ sent-time field as message metadata.

addMsgReadFromMsmqTimeAsMetaData.description: Record the time the message was read from MSMQ as metadata.

metadataKeyForMsgReadFromMsmqTime.description: Metadata key (integer) under which the MSMQ read time is stored.

topicNameIsMsmqFormatName.description: Treat the topicName as an MSMQ format name rather than a direct queue path.

maxMsmqErrorsOnAckToBeHealthy.description: Maximum consecutive MSMQ errors during acknowledgement before the topic is considered unhealthy.

maxMsmqErrorsOnReceiveToBeHealthy.description: Maximum consecutive MSMQ errors during receive before the topic is considered unhealthy.

MsmqDefaultTopicConfig.description: Default MSMQ topic configuration applied to all topics unless overridden in the Topics array.

MsmqTopicsConfig.description: Explicit list of MSMQ topic configurations. Usually empty when defaultTopicConfig covers all topics.

StorageClientCustomConfig.description: STORAGE client-level configuration. Controls how VFS storage directories are discovered and managed.

vfsStorageRootPath.description: Root VFS path used for automatic topic discovery from directory structure.

dirTopicDiscoveryIsRecursive.description: Whether to recursively scan subdirectories when discovering topics from the filesystem.

includeDirParentInTopicName.description: Include the parent directory name as part of the topic name during auto-discovery.

destroyTopicWhenDirIsDeleted.description: Automatically destroy a topic when its backing directory is deleted.

StorageTopicCustomConfig.description: STORAGE topic-level configuration. Controls buffering, VFS paths, codecs, serialization, and lifecycle for storage-backed pub/sub topics.

desiredNrOfBuffers.description: Number of write buffers to maintain. More buffers allow higher throughput at the cost of memory.

desiredMinimalSerializedBlockSize.description: Minimum size in bytes for a serialized block before it is written to storage.

desiredMaxTimeToWaitToGrowSerializedBloc.description: Maximum time (ms) to wait for a block to grow to the desired size before flushing it anyway.

vfsStorageRootPath.description: VFS root path for this topic's storage files. Supports template variables: {topicName}, {pubsubIdPrefix}.

vfsFileExtention.description: File extension for storage files (without leading dot).

encodeCodecFamily.description: Codec family name used to encode (compress/encrypt) data on write. Empty = no encoding.

encodeCodecName.description: Specific codec name within the family for encoding. Empty = auto-select.

decodeCodecFamily.description: Codec family name used to decode data on read. Empty = auto-detect.

decodeCodecName.description: Specific codec name within the family for decoding. Empty = auto-detect.

ticketRefillOnBusyCycle.description: Tickets to refill per busy VFS ops cycle. Controls I/O throughput throttling.

performVfsOpsInDedicatedThread.description: Run VFS operations in a dedicated thread.

applyDedicatedVfsOpsThreadCpuAffinity.description: Pin the dedicated VFS ops thread to a specific CPU core.

cpuAffinityForDedicatedVfsOpsThread.description: CPU core index for the dedicated VFS ops thread (0-based).

collectMetrics.description: Whether to collect metrics for this storage topic.

subscribeWithoutBookmarkIfNoneIsPersiste.description: Begin reading from the start of storage if no persisted bookmark is found.

autoPushAfterStartupIfStorageToPubSub.description: Automatically push stored messages to the downstream pub/sub after startup.

autoPushAfterStartupIsPersistent.description: Keep pushing storage contents persistently rather than stopping after initial catch-up.

youngestStoragePubSubMsgFileToLoad.description: Date/time threshold - only load files newer than this timestamp. Empty = no upper bound.

oldestStoragePubSubMsgFileToLoad.description: Date/time threshold - only load files older than this timestamp. Empty = no lower bound.

defaultCodecDecodeGrowthRatioExpectation.description: Expected ratio by which the decoded data grows vs the encoded data. Used for buffer pre-allocation.

bestEffortDeserializeIsAllowed.description: Allow partial deserialization of corrupt or partially written data.

maxStorageCorruptionDetectionsToBeHealth.description: Maximum corruption detection events before the topic is considered unhealthy. 0 = any corruption is fatal.

maxStorageDeserializationFailuresToBeHea.description: Maximum deserialization failures before the topic is considered unhealthy.

treatEveryFullfilledRequestAsEODEvent.description: Treat every fulfilled read request as an end-of-data event.

deleteContainersWithFullyAckdContent.description: Delete storage container files once all their content has been acknowledged.

moveContainersWithFullyAckdContent.description: Move storage container files to an archive path once all their content has been acknowledged.

vfsStorageRootPathForFullyAckdContainers.description: VFS path where fully-acknowledged container files are moved. Used when moveContainersWithFullyAckdContent=true.

maxCompletedContainerRefsToRetain.description: Maximum number of completed container references to keep in memory.

topicFollowsDirRenames.description: Update the topic name when its backing directory is renamed.

StorageDefaultTopicConfig.description: Default STORAGE topic configuration applied to all topics unless overridden in the Topics array.

StorageTopicsConfig.description: Explicit list of STORAGE topic configurations. Usually empty when defaultTopicConfig covers all topics.

RedisClientCustomConfig.description: ClusteredRedis client-level configuration. In current configurations this is typically empty; topic-level settings carry the main Redis parameters.

autoGenerateRedisAddMinId.description: Automatically generate the XADD MINID (minimum ID) based on maxAgeInMsForMinId.

maxAgeInMsForMinId.description: Maximum age (ms) of messages to retain when autoGenerateRedisAddMinId=true. Default ~1 year.

redisXAddMaxLen.description: Maximum number of messages in the Redis stream (XADD MAXLEN). Use -1 to disable trimming.

redisXAddMaxLenIsApproximate.description: Use approximate trimming ('~' flag on MAXLEN) for better performance.

redisXAddIgnoreMsgId.description: Ignore the pubsub message ID when writing to Redis (use auto-generated Redis IDs).

redisXReadDefaultOffset.description: Default offset for XREAD when no bookmark is available. '0' = read from beginning, '$' = read only new messages.

redisXReadCount.description: Maximum number of messages to read per XREAD call.

redisXReadBlockTimeoutInMs.description: Blocking timeout (ms) for XREAD. The call blocks until a message arrives or the timeout expires.

treatXReadBlockTimeoutAsEndOfDataEvent.description: Treat an XREAD block timeout as an end-of-data event rather than an error.

minAvailableInFlightSlotsBeforeRead.description: Minimum number of available in-flight message slots required before initiating an XREAD.

useDedicatedReadThread.description: Use a dedicated thread for blocking XREAD operations.

RedisDefaultTopicConfig.description: Default ClusteredRedis topic configuration applied to all topics unless overridden in the Topics array.

RedisTopicsConfig.description: Explicit list of ClusteredRedis topic configurations. Usually empty when defaultTopicConfig covers all topics.

UdpClientCustomConfig.description: UDP client-level configuration for sending and receiving UDP datagrams.

transmitTestPackets.description: Continuously transmit test UDP packets for connectivity and throughput testing.

testPacketAsBase64.description: Base64-encoded payload to use for test packets.

wantsTestPackage.description: Whether this topic/socket participates in test packet transmission.

udpInterface.description: UDP interface address and port to bind to for receiving.

ticketRefillOnBusyCycle.description: Processing tickets to refill per busy receive cycle.

nrOfUdpReceiveBuffersPerSocket.description: Number of receive buffers per UDP socket.

udpSocketOsReceiveBufferSize.description: OS-level receive buffer size hint for the UDP socket (bytes).

udpSocketUpdateCyclesPerPulse.description: Number of socket update cycles per processing pulse.

addUdpSourceAddressAsMetaData.description: Add the UDP packet source address as message metadata.

translateUdpSourceAddressToString.description: Convert the binary source address to a human-readable string before storing as metadata.

udpSourceAddressAsMetaDataKeyName.description: Metadata key name for the UDP source address.

maxUdpPacketPayloadSizeInBytes.description: Maximum expected UDP payload size in bytes. Packets larger than this may be truncated.

addTimestampToReceivedPackages.description: Attach a receive timestamp to each incoming UDP packet.

UdpDefaultTopicConfig.description: Default UDP topic configuration applied to all topics unless overridden in the Topics array.

UdpTopicsConfig.description: Explicit list of UDP topic configurations. Usually empty when defaultTopicConfig covers all topics.

WebClientCustomConfig.description: WEB client-level configuration. In current configurations this is typically empty; topic-level settings carry the main HTTP parameters.

WebTopicCustomConfig.description: WEB (HTTP) topic-level configuration for an embedded HTTP server pub/sub endpoint.

httpServerPort.description: TCP port for the embedded HTTP server.

exposeBasicHealthEndpoint.description: Expose a basic HTTP health check endpoint.

basicHealthEndpointPath.description: URL path for the basic health check endpoint (relative, no leading slash).

WebDefaultTopicConfig.description: Default WEB topic configuration applied to all topics unless overridden in the Topics array.

WebTopicsConfig.description: Explicit list of WEB topic configurations. Usually empty when defaultTopicConfig covers all topics.

SqsClientCustomConfig.description: AWS SQS client-level configuration. In current configurations this is typically empty; topic-level settings carry the main SQS parameters.

topicNameIsQueueName.description: Treat the topicName directly as the SQS queue name (rather than a queue URL).

tryToUseSendMessageBatch.description: Use the SQS SendMessageBatch API for higher throughput when publishing multiple messages.

addPrefixWhenSendingKvPairs.description: Prepend a prefix to all key-value pair keys when sending as SQS message attributes.

kvPairPrefixToAddOnSend.description: Prefix string to prepend to key-value pair keys when sending.

addPrefixWhenSendingMetaDataKvPairs.description: Prepend a prefix to all metadata key-value pair keys when sending as SQS message attributes.

metaDatakvPairPrefixToAddOnSend.description: Prefix string to prepend to metadata key-value pair keys when sending.

SqsDefaultTopicConfig.description: Default AWS SQS topic configuration applied to all topics unless overridden in the Topics array.

SqsTopicsConfig.description: Explicit list of AWS SQS topic configurations. Usually empty when defaultTopicConfig covers all topics.

TestClientCustomConfig.description: TEST backend client-level configuration. The TEST backend emulates the STORAGE backend with additional health-control capabilities for testing purposes.

TestTopicCustomConfig.description: TEST backend topic-level configuration. Extends StorageTopicCustomConfig with controls for simulating health state changes.

defaultIsHealthyStatus.description: Initial health status of this test topic. true = healthy, false = unhealthy.

toggleHealthyStatus.description: Whether to periodically toggle the health status (used for failover/spillover testing).

healthyStatusToggleIntervalInMs.description: Interval (ms) between health status toggles when toggleHealthyStatus=true.

healthyStatusToggleIntervalJitter.description: Random jitter (ms) added to healthyStatusToggleIntervalInMs to vary toggle timing.

TestDefaultTopicConfig.description: Default TEST backend topic configuration applied to all topics unless overridden in the Topics array.

TestTopicsConfig.description: Explicit list of TEST backend topic configurations. Usually empty when defaultTopicConfig covers all topics.
